question: In the early 20th century, who among the following published a paper explaining the theory that continental landmasses ‘flowed’ over the Earth, sometimes plowing through the oceans and into each other?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alfred Wegener.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alfred Wegener** published a paper in the early 20th century, explaining the theory that **continental landmasses ‘flowed’ over the Earth**, sometimes plowing through the oceans and into each other.
 
• Alfred Wegener was a **German researcher, geophysicist, and meteorologist.**
 
• The Continental Drift Theory was given by Alfred Wegener in 1912.
 
• The theory is related to the concept of the movement of Earth's continent over a geological time period.
 
• According to the theory, all the continents formed a single continental mass called Panagea and a Mega ocean called Panthalas surrounded it.
 
• It also states that around 200 million years ago the continental mass panagea started splitting into two large continental masses called Laurasia and Gondwana land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **James Hutton **is known as the **Father of Geology**.

 
 
• He formulated geological principles on the basis of his observations of rocks.
 
• He was a Scottish naturalist, physician, and geologist.
